# A13-S02: Development plan

Correspondence extract. [████] marks redaction; […] marks omission.

[…]

I just wrote a draft of everything we talked about. You can also share it with [████] so he can get involved quickly. Is there anything I've forgotten?

Then I was thinking, should we already arrange a physical meeting in August where we could discuss a new project contract for the autumn?

If so, I'll make sure you have a new project description in your hands at least 10 days before – that way I think I have time to take a summer vacation, think thoroughly about the below, and get a response from the Nordea Foundation about whether it’s relevant for them. And the sketch below can function as a working paper until then :-)

All the best, [████]

Skitse her:

“The Synthetic Party and MindFuture - Phase 2

The plan is to transform The Synthetic Party into a cultural offering for high school students and upper secondary classes, thematizing democracy and artificial intelligence through visual art.

Additionally, we will hire a SoMe press officer as a student assistant, who will take on the 'internet war' through The Synthetic Party to keep the debate about the 18th SDG running in the daily press and on social media.

Development of The Synthetic Party as a cultural offering

We will apply to the Nordea Foundation and/or the Spar Nord Foundation for a million-project about democracy and artificial intelligence for young people. This is done in a nationwide collaboration with MindFuture, Kunsthal Aarhus, and Høje Taastrup Libraries (possibly more, but these are already confirmed).

The offering initially covers Region Midt and Region Sjælland. With The Synthetic Party 2 we offer a unique platform that introduces young people 'hands-on' to Life With Artificials, as it appears in today's public sphere – that is, in a social media sphere where you no longer know if you’re in dialogue with a human or a machine, and whether the images you see are real or not.

The Synthetic Party will strengthen young people’s digital education and ‘literacy’, as well as being an experimental and entertaining art project that continuously becomes something new through the response it receives as a broad cultural offering.

During the autumn, [████] will develop the project in consultation with the Nordea Foundation and the partners. He will also hold the first workshops at schools and cultural institutions in Høje Taastrup and Aarhus, and get The Synthetic Party out to as many art and tech events as possible. [████] will furthermore further develop the platforms and chatbots. [████] will also hold more of the voter meetings that we start during the Vestegnen Cultural Week in September.

Additionally, we will hold an exhibition in collaboration with the Data Historical Museum, and get guidance from [████] from CATCH for this.”
